title: Universal Agent Configuration
description: Configuration schema for the Universal Agent in the workspace-centric architecture
$comment: U1 (universal experts): an expert has ONE llm.model. The per-phase tiers llm.strategic / llm.tactical / llm.subagent were removed from this schema; the loader still accepts them in any authored layer (bundled YAML, DB expert, job/thread override, frozen resolved_config) and maps them with a deprecation warning — strategic/tactical lift into llm.model when the layer sets no llm.model (strategic wins; an explicit llm.model in the same layer wins over both), subagent moves to subagents.llm. See knowledge-base/knowledge/features/universal_experts_and_subagents.md §1.1.

$extends.description: Parent config this file deep-merges onto (objects merge, lists replace, null clears). Chain roots: worker_base / session_base / subagent_base — the role overlays under config/overlays/ by their public names (default(s), persistent_default(s) and overlays/<role> are aliases) — and expert_base, the shared root every overlay extends. Any other value names another expert (config/experts/<name>, config/subagents/<name> or config/<name>.yaml) whose own chain is followed. When a config is resolved FOR a role (a job asks for worker, a session for session, a roster entry for subagent), the link that ends the chain is re-rooted onto that role's overlay, so every expert is usable in every role. See knowledge-base/knowledge/features/universal_experts_and_subagents.md §1.1.

$ignore_keys.description: Dotted key paths the config's ROLE ignores — declared by a role overlay (config/overlays/subagent.yaml ignores workspace.backend, autonomy, verification, ...). Pruned from the merged config after every merge, again after the job/thread override layers, and after a roster override: a key that does not apply to a role is dropped silently, never an error. Rides the merge like any list (a child that declares its own list replaces it wholesale; an empty list disables pruning). Never parsed into the agent config.

agent_id.description: Unique identifier for this agent type

description.description: Brief description of what this agent does

icon.description: Material Symbols icon name for expert discovery UI

color.description: Accent color (hex) for expert discovery UI

tags.description: Metadata for categorization and filtering in expert discovery — a soft UI filter, never read for behaviour (U1 D4). Role tags (worker / session / subagent) mark the roles an expert is meant for: the orchestrator derives a bundled expert's role tag from its $extends chain root and a DB expert's from expert_type; `subagent` is authored (library entries under config/subagents/ carry it). Every expert stays usable in every role.

subagents.description: Built-in subagents (universal_experts_and_subagents.md §1.1). `roster` names the children this expert may delegate to: inline small experts (same schema as an expert, resolved on the subagent role overlay) or `$ref` entries — a bundled expert dir name (`critic`), a library entry (`subagents/explorer` / `explorer`) or a DB expert id — with sibling keys deep-merged over the referenced expert. `llm` is the roster-wide model default (below every entry's own `llm`, above the base and the `$ref` target). A job/thread override deep-merges into `subagents.roster.<name>`. Entries are materialised at resolve time (merged chain, settings matrix per entry, parent-only keys pruned); a referenced expert's own `subagents` block is dropped (depth 1). See config/subagents/README.md.

default.description: Roster entry a `delegate_agent` call falls back to when it names no `subagent_type`

llm.description: Roster-wide LLM partial (model / provider / transport / params) applied to every entry that does not pin its own `llm` key. `model: inherit` = the parent's model. A legacy `llm.subagent` tier maps here.

roster.description: Subagent name -> inline entry or `$ref` entry. The name is the child's agent_id and the `subagent_type` the parent passes to `delegate_agent`.

llm.description: LLM configuration: one model per expert (runs every phase and session turn) plus an optional summarization override. Legacy llm.strategic/tactical/subagent keys are accepted by the loader and mapped (see the top-level $comment) but are no longer schema keys.

model.description: Model identifier — the single model every phase runs on

provider.description: LLM provider. Auto-detected from model name if null (claude-* → anthropic, gemini-* → google, codex/* → codex, default → openai). Groq requires explicit setting.

top_p.description: Top-p (nucleus) sampling parameter. null uses provider default.

top_k.description: Top-k sampling parameter. null uses provider default.

reasoning_level.description: Reasoning depth for models that support it

reasoning_method.description: How reasoning level is delivered. 'prompt' injects in system prompt (gpt-oss). 'api' passes as API parameter (OpenAI, OpenRouter). 'none' disables (Anthropic, Google, Groq). null auto-detects from model name.

base_url.description: Custom API base URL (null for default)

timeout.description: Request timeout in seconds (null for no timeout, default 600s = 10 minutes)

max_retries.description: Number of retries for failed LLM requests with exponential backoff

multimodal.description: Whether the primary model can process images directly. When true, visual content (document screenshots, images) is sent as base64-encoded images. When false, visual content is converted to text descriptions via a separate vision model.

parallel_tool_calls.description: Allow the model to make multiple tool calls per response. Enable for models that handle parallel calls well (e.g., GPT-5.2 Pro, Opus 4.6).

max_output_tokens.description: Override max output tokens (auto-detected if null)

summarization.description: LLM overrides for context summarization. Can use different model for compacting conversation history.

structure.description: Directories to create in the workspace. Standard: archive/ (phase history), output/ (deliverables), reference/ (domain material), tools/ (auto-generated tool docs)

instructions_template.description: Name of the instructions template file

initial_files.description: Files to copy into workspace on initialization. Keys are destination paths, values are source paths relative to src/agent/config/

max_read_words.description: Maximum word count for workspace read operations. For non-PDF files, estimated from file size (bytes / 5.5). For PDFs, counted during page iteration.

max_write_words.description: Maximum word count for a single write_file call. Returns an error with guidance to split into multiple calls if exceeded.

vm.description: Sizing of the VM workspace (workspace.backend = vm). Ignored on container and virtual backends. Jobs set these via config_override.workspace.vm.

image.description: VM base image reference. Omit for the deployment default (the current golden image).

cpu_cores.description: Virtual CPU cores for the VM.

memory.description: Guest memory as a Kubernetes quantity (e.g. 24Gi).

disk_size.description: Rootdisk size as a Kubernetes quantity (e.g. 120Gi). Omit for the deployment's controller default; a value below that default is raised to it, because the clone target cannot be smaller than the golden image it is cloned from.

max_read_size.description: DEPRECATED: Use max_read_words instead. If max_read_words is not set, falls back to max_read_size / 5.5.

git_versioning.description: Enable git versioning for workspace history. Creates a git repository in the workspace for automatic change tracking.

backend.description: Workspace backend type. 'sandbox' (SSH/SFTP to an isolated workspace container) and 'vm' (SSH/SFTP to a KubeVirt VM with sudo gate) get the full shell/git/browser toolset. The lite tiers run with no workspace pod (no_workspace_agent_mode.md): 'virtual' exposes object-store-backed file tools (no shell/git/browser); 'none' exposes no file tools at all. Shell/browser/git are gated off automatically for the lite tiers by backend capability, not by config. The agent never operates on its own filesystem.

remote.description: Remote backend settings (only used when backend: remote)

key_path.description: Path to SSH private key file

workspace_path.description: Workspace root path on remote (subdirectory of agent home)

tools.description: Tool configuration by category: one field per TOOL_REGISTRY category, plus mcp. Each value is POLICY, not membership: true / false / {only: [...]} / {except: [...]}, or the legacy spellings (a bare list = only; [] = false). See knowledge-base/knowledge/features/tool_config_policy_vs_membership.md.

agent_catalog.description: Agent catalog tools: manage experts and skills. Primarily for persistent agents (src/agent/tools/orchestrator/catalog.py). Policy, not membership: true / false / {only: [...]} / {except: [...]}, or a bare list.

browser_direct.description: Direct browser-control tools (src/agent/tools/research/browser_direct.py). Policy, not membership: true / false / {only: [...]} / {except: [...]}, or a bare list.

catalog_authoring.description: Catalogue-authoring tools: create or update experts, skills and automations from portable JSON bundles (src/agent/tools/orchestrator/catalog.py, workflows.py). Split out of agent_catalog/workflows so those groups hold only reads and their `true` expansion is safe by construction. Gated by the catalog_authoring capability grant, deny-by-default, because these tools write rows the user's other agents then run. Policy, not membership: true / false / {only: [...]} / {except: [...]}, or a bare list.

canvas.description: Dynamic Canvas presentation tools for persistent sessions (src/agent/tools/canvas/). Policy, not membership: true / false / {only: [...]} / {except: [...]}, or a bare list.

citation.description: Citation management tools (src/agent/tools/citation/). Policy, not membership: true / false / {only: [...]} / {except: [...]}, or a bare list.

communication.description: Communication tools: agent-initiated messaging to humans via email (src/agent/tools/communication/). Policy, not membership: true / false / {only: [...]} / {except: [...]}, or a bare list.

core.description: Core tools: todo management + job completion (src/agent/tools/core/). Policy, not membership: true / false / {only: [...]} / {except: [...]}, or a bare list.

delegation.description: Built-in subagent tools: `delegate_agent` plus `wait_agent`, `message_agent`, `stop_agent`, and `list_agents` (src/agent/tools/delegation/). Every tool is explicit: it binds only when named here AND `delegation.enabled` is true. New configuration must use false, a bare list, or {only: [...]} — true and {except: [...]} are rejected so later control tools never appear without a reviewed grant. Stored legacy true and the deleted names `spawn_subagent` / `delegate_work` / `resume_delegation_child` normalize only to `delegate_agent`, with a deprecation warning.

oneOf.description: Only `false` is accepted here. delegation must enumerate its tools: only `{only: [...]}` (or a bare list, the same thing) and `false` (or []) are accepted. `true` and `except` both auto-track the registry, so later background controls would otherwise land in an expert with no reviewed grant.

Only `{only: [...]}` is accepted here. delegation must enumerate its tools: only `{only: [...]}` (or a bare list, the same thing) and `false` (or []) are accepted. `true` and `except` both auto-track the registry, so later background controls would otherwise land in an expert with no reviewed grant.

email.description: email tools. Machine-owned: every tool here is code-granted (an email datasource is attached (tier from its config.access)), so `true` resolves to [] and the key is better deleted than declared. Policy, not membership: true / false / {only: [...]} / {except: [...]}, or a bare list.

evaluation.description: Evaluation/verdict tools for critic agents: approve or return jobs with feedback (src/agent/tools/evaluation/). Policy, not membership: true / false / {only: [...]} / {except: [...]}, or a bare list.

git.description: Git version control tools for workspace history (src/agent/tools/git/). Policy, not membership: true / false / {only: [...]} / {except: [...]}, or a bare list.

graph.description: Neo4j graph tools (src/agent/tools/graph/). Injected automatically when a Neo4j datasource is attached to the job. Usually left empty in config. Machine-owned: every tool here is code-granted (a neo4j datasource is attached), so `true` resolves to [] and the key is better deleted than declared. Policy, not membership: true / false / {only: [...]} / {except: [...]}, or a bare list.

knowledge.description: Knowledge base tools: project knowledge CRUD + search (src/agent/tools/knowledge/). Policy, not membership: true / false / {only: [...]} / {except: [...]}, or a bare list.

loop.description: Loop campaign tools (src/agent/tools/loop/); injected per job via config_override for a planner loop's checkpoint critic, never listed in bundled configs. Policy, not membership: true / false / {only: [...]} / {except: [...]}, or a bare list.

mcp.description: MCP datasource tools, discovered at runtime; no static registry membership, so `true` resolves to the '*' sentinel expanded after MCP discovery. Policy, not membership: true / false / {only: [...]} / {except: [...]}, or a bare list.

mongodb.description: MongoDB query tools (src/agent/tools/mongodb/). Injected automatically when a MongoDB datasource is attached to the job. Machine-owned: every tool here is code-granted (a mongodb datasource is attached), so `true` resolves to [] and the key is better deleted than declared. Policy, not membership: true / false / {only: [...]} / {except: [...]}, or a bare list.

job_control.description: Canonical job-control writes generated from src/shared/orch_surface/jobs descriptors. Policy, not membership: true / false / {only: [...]} / {except: [...]}, or a bare list.

job_inspection.description: Canonical job inspection reads generated from src/shared/orch_surface/jobs descriptors. Policy, not membership: true / false / {only: [...]} / {except: [...]}, or a bare list.

orchestrator.description: Non-job orchestrator application tools for projects, repositories, catalog/workflows, and session context. Policy, not membership: true / false / {only: [...]} / {except: [...]}, or a bare list.

product_help.description: Product-guide reader tools (src/agent/tools/product_help.py, src/agent/tools/product_capabilities.py). Machine-owned: every tool here is code-granted (persistent-session floor; see each tool's own gate), so `true` resolves to [] and the key is better deleted than declared. Policy, not membership: true / false / {only: [...]} / {except: [...]}, or a bare list.

repo.description: Repository-datasource write tools (src/agent/tools/repo/); distinct from `git`, which is the workspace's own version control. Machine-owned: every tool here is code-granted (a repository datasource is attached), so `true` resolves to [] and the key is better deleted than declared. Policy, not membership: true / false / {only: [...]} / {except: [...]}, or a bare list.

research.description: Research/web search tools (src/agent/tools/research/). Policy, not membership: true / false / {only: [...]} / {except: [...]}, or a bare list.

session_task.description: Lightweight session todo tools (src/agent/tools/core/session_task_tools.py). Machine-owned: every tool here is code-granted (persistent session, unconditional (src/agent/api/persistent_session.py:1415)), so `true` resolves to [] and the key is better deleted than declared. Policy, not membership: true / false / {only: [...]} / {except: [...]}, or a bare list.

shell.description: Shell tools: command execution (src/agent/tools/shell/). shell must enumerate its tools: only `{only: [...]}` (or a bare list, the same thing) and `false` (or []) are accepted. `true` and `except` both auto-track the registry, so a tool added to the shell category later would land here with no diff to review; for a code-execution category that is the wrong default.

sql.description: PostgreSQL query tools (src/agent/tools/sql/). Injected automatically when a PostgreSQL datasource is attached to the job. Machine-owned: every tool here is code-granted (a postgresql datasource is attached), so `true` resolves to [] and the key is better deleted than declared. Policy, not membership: true / false / {only: [...]} / {except: [...]}, or a bare list.

webdav.description: WebDAV / cloud-storage tools (src/agent/tools/webdav/). Machine-owned: every tool here is code-granted (a webdav datasource is attached), so `true` resolves to [] and the key is better deleted than declared. Policy, not membership: true / false / {only: [...]} / {except: [...]}, or a bare list.

workflows.description: Workflow tools: inspect automations and project loops, and draft disabled automations. Primarily for persistent agents (src/agent/tools/orchestrator/workflows.py). Policy, not membership: true / false / {only: [...]} / {except: [...]}, or a bare list.

workspace.description: Workspace file operation tools (src/agent/tools/workspace/). Policy, not membership: true / false / {only: [...]} / {except: [...]}, or a bare list.

instruction_files.description: Instruction files or bound skills with bounded activation: one-shot phase-start injection or a required read before a tool action.

file.description: Workspace-relative target path for the instruction file (e.g., 'todo_guide.md' or 'instructions/review_guide.md')

skill.description: Bundled skill name, materialized as skills/<name>/SKILL.md; mutually exclusive with file

trigger.description: Trigger condition: before_tool:<tool> gates an action; phase_start:<phase> injects once per concrete phase. Legacy phase:<phase> is a once-only compatibility alias.

enforce.description: When true on a before_tool binding, reject the action until the artifact has been read. Phase-start bindings are injected once regardless of this compatibility field; false never enables continuous injection.

phases.description: Optional phase-kind filter for before_tool enforcement

read_scope.description: Whether a successful instruction read remains valid for the worker run or only the current concrete phase

max_read_age_turns.description: Optional maximum LLM-turn age of a read before a before_tool gate closes again

limits.description: Behavioral execution limits. Model-dependent limits (context_threshold_tokens, model_max_context_tokens, etc.) are set via settings_matrix.yaml.

message_count_threshold.description: Message count threshold for triggering summarization (requires min tokens too)

tool_retry_count.description: Number of retries for failed tool calls

llm_inproc_retries.description: Tier-1 in-process LLM-invoke retries before the worker freezes the job for pause+backoff re-dispatch (llm_outage_pause_and_backoff_redispatch.md)

max_content_length.description: Character threshold for excessive length warning (only when no tool calls)

max_tag_repetitions.description: Flag if the same closing XML/HTML tag appears more than this many times

max_token_repetitions.description: Flag if the same token/word repeats consecutively more than this many times

max_line_repetitions.description: Flag if the same line appears more than this many times in the output

progress_stall_threshold.description: Tool calls without progress before nudge reminder is injected

max_tool_calls_per_phase.description: Optional per-phase tool-call ceiling (0 = off). Superseded by max_tool_calls_per_job, which bounds the job rather than resetting each boundary

max_tool_calls_per_job.description: Job-wide tool-call ceiling — the only automatic stop for a runaway job. Exceeding it freezes with budget_exceeded for human review (0 disables)

tool_category_timeouts.description: Per-tool-category audited batch timeout ceilings (seconds). Empty values use graph defaults.

default.description: Fallback timeout for categories not explicitly listed

act_ratio_nudge_threshold.description: Consecutive tool actions touching only process artifacts before the act-ratio 'stop planning' nudge fires (0 disables)

progress_push_interval_seconds.description: Minimum seconds between progress pushes to the workspace remote. Commits are unthrottled; only the network round-trip is rate-limited

progress_wip_commit_after_seconds.description: Seconds without a commit before the turn loop commits work in progress, covering agents stuck on a single long todo (0 disables)

queued_reply_max_wait_seconds.description: Maximum seconds a queued (non-urgent) reply waits for a natural break (a completed todo) before being delivered anyway (0 = break-driven only)

process_artifact_patterns.description: fnmatch patterns (workspace-relative) classifying file targets as process artifacts for the act-ratio tripwire

phase_settings.description: Phase alternation bounds enforced by TodoManager.stage_tactical_todos (next_phase_todos)

min_todos.description: Minimum todos required for a strategic->tactical transition (worker_base sets 2)

max_todos.description: Maximum todos allowed for a strategic->tactical transition

compact_on_archive.description: Trigger context compaction when archiving todos

keep_recent_tool_results.description: Number of recent tool results to preserve in full during context compaction. Higher values retain more context but slow compaction.

keep_recent_messages.description: Number of recent messages to preserve during compaction and trimming

summarization_template.description: Filename of summarization prompt template (in prompts/ folder)

reasoning_level.description: Reasoning effort level for summarization. Only injected in prompt when reasoning_method is 'prompt'.

max_summary_length.description: Maximum summary length in tokens (injected as {max_summary_length} in prompt)

proxy.description: Proxy configuration for institutional access (e.g., SSH tunnel to university VPN)

enabled.description: Enable proxy for research tool requests

browser.description: Browser tool configuration (workspace-side browser-exec daemon; the agent pod never runs a browser)

snapshot.description: Page-state results returned by the direct browser tools

include_screenshot.description: Include screenshots in results: "auto" (if model is multimodal), true, or false

max_dom_chars.description: Truncate DOM text beyond this many characters

security.description: URL validation applied agent-side before dispatching actions

blocked_schemes.description: URL schemes that are always rejected

shell.description: Shell command execution settings (tmux-backed terminal multiplexer). Requires tmux installed.

mode.description: Shell mode: 'stateless' exposes run_command (simple command→output), 'persistent' exposes shell_execute (full tab management, keys, async)

max_tabs.description: Maximum number of concurrent shell tabs. Agent must close tabs before opening new ones when limit is reached.

scrollback_limit.description: Tmux history-limit per pane (scrollback buffer size)

default_timeout.description: Default timeout for synchronous command execution in seconds

blocked_commands.description: Commands blocked from execution for safety (sudo has its own intercept via sudo_action)

sudo_action.description: How to handle sudo commands: 'freeze' (intercept and offer VM upgrade), 'block' (hard reject), 'allow' (pass through, for VM-backed agents)

sandbox.description: Restrict working directory to workspace root

interactive.description: Settings for persistent interactive mode (--mode persistent). Controls permission defaults and idle behavior.

permission_mode.description: Default permission mode for tool execution in interactive sessions

idle_timeout_minutes.description: Auto-end session after idle period in minutes (0 = disabled)

narration_mode.description: How much the agent narrates its work in an interactive session. Changed live through the session control endpoint ('narration.set'), which enforces the same vocabulary.

verification.description: Verification phase: auto-spawn a critic job after job_complete to review deliverables. The critic either approves the job or resumes it with feedback. See knowledge-base/knowledge/features/verification_phase.md.

enabled.description: Opt-in: spawn a critic job after job_complete freezes the job as pending_review

critic_config.description: Expert config name to use for the reviewer job

max_rounds.description: Max critic/worker feedback round-trips before the job is auto-accepted (0 = unlimited). worker_base ships 5; 3 is the code default when the key is absent.

scholar.description: Scholar phase: auto-spawn a research job before the main job starts. The scholar gathers information, does web research, and writes findings to the research/ folder. The main job starts after the scholar completes.

enabled.description: Spawn a scholar research job before the main job starts

scholar_config.description: Expert config name to use for the research job

delegation.description: The built-in subagents' settings (universal_experts_and_subagents.md §0 D7; runtime in src/agent/subagents/). `enabled` gates `delegate_agent` and all four background controls; each tool exists only when also named in `tools.delegation`. Which children exist, their model, tools, write policy and budgets live in `subagents.roster`; a child never delegates or receives the control plane (depth 1). The pre-U3 keys (`max_depth`, `default_timeout`, `max_timeout`, `allowed_configs`, `mode`, `light`) are no longer accepted by this schema; the loader still drops them from any authored layer with a deprecation warning.

enabled.description: Opt-in: the expert may bind explicitly named spawn/control tools from `tools.delegation`

max_concurrent.description: Roster runtime (D7): how many `delegate_agent` children may run concurrently per parent; calls above the cap queue and run in waves. Values below 1 are raised to 1 by the loader.

run_in_background_default.description: Roster runtime: the `run_in_background` value used only when a `delegate_agent` call omits the argument. false = wait for the report as this tool result; true = return a durable receipt and push the child's completion automatically. An explicit false always wins.

autonomy.description: Controls when the agent pauses for human review. full=never, review=after job_complete, partial=after first strategic + job_complete, guided=after every strategic + job_complete, dependent=after every phase + job_complete.

image_quality.description: Resolution tier of images delivered to the model. economy=~768px, standard=~1568px, high=model-family max edge. Higher = more visual detail and more image tokens. Applied (downscale/re-encode) at the image seam; overridable per session/job.

subagentRosterEntry.description: One `subagents.roster` entry. Inline: any expert-schema key (the entry resolves on the subagent overlay: expert_base <- overlays/subagent <- these keys). Reference: `$ref` plus optional sibling keys deep-merged over the referenced expert. Keys that do not apply to a child (workspace.backend, autonomy, verification, phase_settings, delegation, tools.delegation, communication, scholar, curator, officer, headless — the subagent overlay's `$ignore_keys`) are pruned, never errors. `isolation`, `write_policy`, `return` and the child budgets under `limits` are U3 runtime keys carried verbatim on the resolved entry in U1.

$ref.description: A bundled expert dir name (`critic` / `experts/critic`), a library entry (`explorer` / `subagents/explorer`) or a DB expert id (UUID). Never a path. Sibling keys override the referenced expert.

description.description: What this child is for — the text the parent model sees next to the `subagent_type`. Required in spirit for inline entries.

llm.description: The child's model / transport / params. `model: inherit` (the subagent overlay's default) = the parent's model + transport, materialised at resolve time.

tools.description: The child's tool groups. Unqualified children get the subagent overlay's read-only floor; a `$ref` to a fuller expert keeps that expert's tools (minus `delegation`).

prompts.description: Prompt files or text. Inline entries name files resolved against the parent expert's directory (`_deployment_dir` on the resolved entry); a DB-referenced expert's prompt text is inlined by the resolver. Read by the roster runtime (U3).

isolation.description: U3: where the child works — the parent's tree (`shared`) or its own git worktree. A per-call `isolation` may override.

write_policy.description: U3: what the child may write (owned paths come from the brief).

limits.description: The ordinary `limits` keys plus the child budgets the roster runtime enforces (U3): max_turns, max_tokens, return_budget_tokens, stale_idle_s, stale_in_tool_s. Operator-owned, never model-facing parameters.

return.description: U3: the shape of what the child hands back to the parent.

llmPhaseOverride.description: Partial LLM overrides (llm.summarization). Only specified fields override the base config.

top_p.description: Top-p (nucleus) sampling override for this phase

top_k.description: Top-k sampling override for this phase

reasoning_method.description: Override how reasoning level is delivered for this phase

multimodal.description: Override whether this phase's model can process images directly

parallel_tool_calls.description: Override parallel tool calls for this phase

max_output_tokens.description: Override max output tokens for this phase

model_max_context_tokens.description: Hard limit for this phase model's context window. Overrides the base llm.model_max_context_tokens for this phase.
